title: Mirror Equation
notes: Follow standard Cartesian sign conventions ($f = R/2$).

title: Magnification, Height and Distance Relationship in Mirror

title: Refractive Index Equations
notes: Snell's Law: $n_1 \sin i = n_2 \sin r$. Frequency $\nu$ remains constant during refraction.

title: Critical Angle Equation (Total Internal Reflection)
formula: $$\sin i_c = \frac{n_2}{n_1} = \frac{1}{n_{12}} \quad [\text{for air as rarer medium: } \sin i_c = \frac{1}{n}]$$
notes: Light must travel from a denser medium ($n_1$) to a rarer medium ($n_2$) with angle of incidence $i > i_c$.

title: Lens Maker's Formula
notes: $n_2$ is the refractive index of the lens material, $n_1$ is the surrounding medium.

title: Thin Lens Formula
notes: Convex lens has $f > 0$; concave lens has $f < 0$.

title: Magnification, Height and Distance Relationship for Lens
notes: Positive sign for $v/u$ contrasts with the mirror formula's negative sign.

title: Power of a Lens
notes: Unit: Dioptre (D). Converging lens: $P > 0$; diverging lens: $P < 0$.

title: Combination of Thin Lenses in Contact
notes: For two thin lenses separated by distance $d$: $\frac{1}{f} = \frac{1}{f_1} + \frac{1}{f_2} - \frac{d}{f_1 f_2}$.

title: Prism: Deviation, Refractive Index & Minimum Deviation
formula: $$A = r_1 + r_2, \quad \delta = i + e - A, \quad n = \frac{\sin\left(\frac{A + D_m}{2}\right)}{\sin\left(\frac{A}{2}\right)}, \quad \delta = (n - 1)A \quad [\text{thin prism}]$$
notes: At minimum deviation ($D_m$): $i = e$, $r_1 = r_2 = A/2$, and the refracted ray passes parallel to the base.

title: Magnification of Simple Microscope
formula: $$m = 1 + \frac{D}{f} \quad [\text{image at near point } D], \qquad m = \frac{D}{f} \quad [\text{image at infinity / relaxed eye}]$$
notes: $D$ is the least distance of distinct vision ($25\text{ cm}$). Short focal length gives higher magnification.
